text:
Noah P.: hey folks, day 2. a couple security-ish questions: 1) My corp laptop is delayed  can I use a loaner from IT or do a BYOD exception? 2) I signed up for hardware token but shipping estimate is 7 days  any temporary MFA options? 3) The phish sim email asks to report suspicious emails  what counts as reporting (reply, forward, report button)? 4) Where do I upload the completion screenshot for the security quiz?

Mira (People Ops): welcome Noah! :wave: TL;DR: IT can loan a laptop for 2 weeks if available, otherwise BYOD with MDM + disk encryption. Temporary MFA: you can use a TOTP app on a personal device or request a temporary soft token (expires in 14 days). Phish sim reporting: use the "Report Phish" button in the mail client or forward to phishing@redwood.infra. Quiz proof: upload to the LMS or attach a screenshot in your onboarding ticket.

IT Helpdesk: @Noah P. Loaner policy: open a ticket with subject "Loaner laptop request". Inventory is limited; we prioritize new hires. For BYOD enroll: install our MDM (link: https://redwood.infra/mdm), enable FileVault/BitLocker, and install Okta Verify if you don't want to use TOTP. If you need a temporary soft token, choose "Temporary MFA" in the ticket and we'll issue a token that auto-revokes. Example enroll commands (macOS):
```bash
sudo /opt/redwood/enroll_device.sh --mdm
fdesetup status
```
Paste the fdesetup output into the ticket.

Noah P.: quick Q about reporting phish  will reporting trigger follow-up or documentation in my record? i'm nervous about false positives.

Security Team: good Q. Reporting is encouraged and doesn't count as a failure. If you report, security will triage and may reply with a teaching note. Phish sim results are only visible to Security + People Ops for training metrics; individual flags are anonymized in quarterly summaries unless there are repeated risky behaviors, in which case we'll reach out privately with coaching.

Noah P.: ok that helps. also is the security addendum signature required before we grant sandbox KMS roles or afterward?

Mira (People Ops): sign the security addendum in the offer portal ASAP. For sandbox KMS we generally need the signed acknowledgement before granting access. If it's urgent for a demo we can provision a time-limited role once manager signs off.

IT Helpdesk: If you want to speed this up, include your manager and the sandbox repo names in the ticket. For proof of encryption on mac, paste `fdesetup status` output. For Windows, paste `manage-bde -status C:`.

Noah P.: thanks. last tiny thing  if i accidentally clicked a phish link, what should i do right now?

Security Team: Stop interacting with the page, disconnect VPN, change passwords if prompted, and DM security with the URL and a short timeline. We'll spin up an incident checklist if needed. No blame  the focus is containment and learning.

Onboard Bot: Reminder: Security quiz "Foundations" due in 4 days. Loaner ticket template: https://redwood.infra/tickets/loaner. Phishing sim window for new hires: 1765195000 - 1765281400.
